title: An apartment water interruption
passage: Residents of Green Court, please note that water service will be interrupted on Tuesday from nine until eleven in the morning. A contractor will replace a valve in the main supply line. Please fill any containers you may need before nine. The elevators and electricity will operate normally. After service returns, let the cold water run briefly if it appears cloudy. Contact the building office if the problem continues. The office will remain open throughout the work.
passageZh: Green Court 住戶請注意：星期二上午九點至十一點將暫停供水。承包商會更換主供水管線中的一個閥門。請在九點前裝好需要的用水。電梯與電力將正常運作。恢復供水後，若冷水看起來混濁，請先讓它短暫流一會兒。如果問題持續，請聯絡管理室。施工期間管理室照常開放。
